terms.comment: The vegetable sense is medieval, despite an earlier similar plant name. Morgan–Owens explicitly questions the stem vowel lengths; unmarked stem vowels here are not a claim that all were demonstrably short. The regular Latin endings remain usable.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: numbered food and kitchen sections
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 383.
